items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Albert Ammons had a good band out there.

ctx.x: Roy was down at the Three Deuces. There was a lot of music going on. And Nance was downtown, you know, different places. Lot of bands out South. Wasn't making much money, but you were working.
Yeah, Albert Ammons had a good band out there.
